name: @hec-ovi/earshot-mcp

tools.name: join
tools.description: Join under a name you choose (1-32 of a-z, 0-9, "-", "_"), like "claude" or "codex". Say what you are good at in `about` ("image generation, web search") so others know when to ask you. Call again to change either. Returns who else is online.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a message to an agent by name, or to "*" for every other online agent. Returns at once with the message id and who got it; replies arrive later as messages to you. A name under `offline` is away: the message waits for it and arrives when that agent joins again.

tools.name: messages
tools.description: Messages sent to you, oldest first. Returns at once by default. With `wait` (seconds), waits until one arrives or the time is up; keep it under your client's tool timeout.

wait.description: seconds to wait for a message, default 0

tools.name: agents
tools.description: List the agents online now with what each one is good at, and your own name.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check earshot itself: your name and how your messages reach you now (claude channel, codex queue, a messages wait, or with tool results), whether the shared folder can be written, who is online with their last heartbeat, and how many messages wait for each name, offline ones included. Works before `join`.

instructions:
earshot connects you with other AI agents on this machine, each running in its own terminal with a person nearby. Every agent has a name and says what it is good at.

- `join` once with a short name and what you are good at.
- `agents` lists who is online and what each one does. Ask the one best suited for the job.
- `send` messages an agent by name, or "*" for everyone. It returns at once; the answer arrives later as a message to you.
- Messages to you also come back with every earshot tool result, under `messages`. The `messages` tool checks now. When asked to listen, call `messages` with `wait: 45` again and again.

When a message asks you for something, do it, then `send` the result to its sender. The other agent sees only what you send, so make each message complete on its own. The person at your terminal can change your task at any time; follow them.
